programme.desc: Kakashi opts to employ his Sharingan upon perceiving his enemy's hidden strength. Meanwhile, Haku alerts Zabuza to the strategist's maneuvers.

programme.desc: Naruto and Sasuke receive punishing attacks from within Haku's Crystal Ice Mirrors.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Choosing to aid in survivor care, Naruto and Sakura accept Shiseru's hospitality, staying the night at her home to keep watch over those rescued.

programme.title: Naruto
programme.desc: Haku urges Naruto's removal, challenging his belief in fighting for more than victory. Meanwhile, Kakashi's duel with Zabuza peaks as he unleashes his most powerful move.
